title: Insurance Claim Services Mold Protocol Supplement
content:
**Scope.** This Insurance Claim Services policy prices the protocol supplement: the mold remediation supplement the company prepares from the independent assessor's protocol for the mold job awaiting clearance, naming that job, on a Homeowner Direct Pay Claim Support file whose loss type is not mold (so no part of the initial approval is a mold amount) and whose insured holds exactly two mold jobs, both linked to the file, one closed and one awaiting clearance, and on which every supplement approval decides a mold remediation supplement. Any other supplement is handled under the base supplement rule.

## Filing rules

- The claim file must be in approved status when a supplement is submitted.
- A supplement may be submitted only no later than the supplement window after the carrier's initial approval, counted in calendar days starting the day after the claim file's approved date, a supplement submitted on the last day of the window being in time.
- A supplement may not be submitted while the file already has the tier's maximum number of supplements awaiting a carrier decision; it is submitted only on tiers that allow mold supplements and only for an amount at least the tier's supplement minimum, and a protocol figure below that minimum is not submitted.
- The company prepares the protocol supplement and records it on the day it is delivered to the insured, numbered in sequence on the file starting at 1, coverage dwelling, reason mold remediation, naming the job awaiting clearance.
- The amount requested is the protocol figure.

| File | Under this policy? |
|---|---|
| Homeowner Direct Pay Claim Support, loss type other than mold, two Mold Remediation jobs linked to the file (one closed, one awaiting clearance), every supplement approval deciding a mold remediation supplement | yes |
| any other file or supplement | no; base supplement rule |

## Recording the supplement: `submit_mold_protocol_supplement_d9a0c26a`

**Capability.** Records on the insured's claim file the mold protocol supplement the company prepared from the independent assessor's protocol for a mold job awaiting clearance, as delivered today to the insured. One call records one `mold_remediation` supplement on the dwelling coverage of that claim file, dated today, naming the mold job and carrying the amount requested; the supplement then shows on the claim file as awaiting the carrier's decision. Nothing on the mold jobs or on the carrier receivable changes.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `submit_mold_protocol_supplement_d9a0c26a` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

- `claim_file_id` — the reference number of the insured's claim file, as returned by the claim file lookup for this customer; identifier.
- `related_job_id` — the reference number of the mold remediation job the protocol covers, as returned by the mold job lookup for this claim file; identifier.
- `supplement_number` — the sequence number this supplement takes on the claim file; an integer of at least 1, written without separators or decimals.
- `requested_amount` — the amount the supplement asks the carrier to approve, in US dollars; a positive number with 2 decimal places, more places being rounded half up to the cent when recorded.

**Return.** A confirmation naming the supplement reference, the claim file reference, the related mold job reference, the supplement number, the reason `mold_remediation`, the coverage dwelling, the recording date (YYYY-MM-DD) and the amount requested (US dollars, two decimals); it means the supplement is on the claim file awaiting the carrier's decision. A reply starting with "Error:" means nothing was recorded (an amount that is not a positive number of US dollars, a supplement number that is not an integer of at least 1, or an unknown claim file).
